products.name: DeLaurenti Housemade Marinara, 16oz
products.description: Made in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. This is your go-to sauce to have at the ready in your freezer. DOP tomatoes, onions, garlic, extra virgin olive oil...only the best ingredients. Great as is, or ready to customize with sausage or spice!

products.name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meat Sauce, 16oz
products.description: Made in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. This is your go-to sauce to have at the ready in your freezer. DOP tomatoes, Cascioppo's sausage, onions, garlic, extra virgin olive oil...only the best ingredients. Ready to go as is - just add pasta!

products.name: DeLaurenti Housemade Pizza Sauce, 16oz
products.description: As seen, and enjoyed, in our cafe! The same sauce that has been on the classic cheese & pepperoni pizza you have enjoyed for years in our shop! Made in our kitchen with the perfect blend of the best tomatoes, herbs & spices! No need to recreate it, you just need to bring it home and put it on a pizza!

products.name: DeLaurenti Pesto
products.description: The house pesto that you have found in our freezer for years. A must have for home. Having pesto at the ready will provide you with effortless pasta, pizza & panini options, plus the security of knowing that it's resting in your freezer will help you sleep better!

products.name: Ciacco Lemon Basil Pesto
products.description: Genovese DOP basil, EVOO, pine nuts, cheese, salt, garlic, wine vinegar,and lemon...as simple as it gets but packs a punch of flavor to anything you add it to. Not just for pasta, you can use this mixed into yogurt for a savory dip or spread it on Piadina for a sandwich.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo al Funghi Porcini, 500g
products.description: Our house brand tomato and porcini sauce is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. And yes, there are real porcini mushrooms in this sauce. Great with your favorite cut of pasta or served over polenta.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo al Tartufo, 500g
products.description: Vine ripened tomatoes...truffles...any questions? This sauce has the rich flavor of truffle, garlic, and mushroom without an overpowering aroma. The perfect addition to fresh egg linguine, or your famous polenta.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Puttanesca, 500g
products.description: Our house brand Puttanesca sauce is made with Italian cherry tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add green olives, capers and pine nuts and you have a sweet, savory and mildly spicy version of a regional favorite. Perfect with bucatini, or any other cut of pasta with ruffled edges to soak up the sauce.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Vodka, 500g
products.description: Our house brand Sugo alla Vodka is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. The sauce is finished with a dash of vodka, fresh cream, garlic and basil. Perfect for your favorite cut of pasta, cheese ravioli or tortellini.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, 500g
products.description: Our Sugo della Casa - the house sauce. Made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. You will recognize and be able to pronouce the following ingredients: tomatoes, olive oil, celery, carrots, Barolo wine, sea salt and herbs. Great for a quick weeknight pasta with Cascioppo's sausage or as the sauce for your lasagna with Calabro fresh ricotta.

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo Due Formaggi, 500g
products.description: Our house brand Sugo Due Formaggi is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add sharp aged pecorino, creamy ricotta and fresh herbs and you have perfect sauce for your favorite cut of pasta or your ravioli!

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo Piccante, 500g
products.description: Just like the Sugo della Casa - house tomato sauce, but with a little kick of spice. Made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made, the addition of just enough Italian chili pepper give this sauce a warm, pleasant spice.

products.name: Monte's Marinara Tomato Sauce, 16oz
products.description: There is 100+ years & 3 generations of family tradition behind this sauce. The Monte Family emigrated to Brooklyn from Sant’Angelo di Lombardi & Avellino, Italy in 1906 and began serving traditional Neopolitan Fare to the community at what opened as Angelo’s Tavern - eventually to become known as the famed Monte’s Venetian Room. This sauce has been enjoyed by everyone from Frank Sinatra to James Cagney. The foundation is the tomatoes. Vine ripened & grown in California, the family swears that they are every bit as good as the Italian variety. This Marinara is the same great recipe of their Oringal Tomato Sauce, just thicker!

products.name: Monte's Spicy Tomato Sauce, 24oz
products.description: There is 100+ years & 3 generations of family tradition behind this sauce. products.name: Strianese Organic Passata, 720g
products.description: Tomatoes did not start in Italy, but the Italians found the best place to grown them - the San Marzano Valley outside of Naples in Southern Italy. The Strianese company is a great producer of DOP (Denominazione di Origine Protetta) and organic tomatoes. We have been using their products in our kitchen and in our homes for many years. This fresh, organic strained tomato puree is a perfect back drop for all your seasonings - be it in tomato sauce, braises or soups. It's lighter than tomato sauce and without the chunky texture of peeled plum tomatoes. Use a little, put the cap back on, put it in the fridge and have it ready for the next time you want to add the fresh taste of San Marzano Tomatoes.

products.name: Strianese Organic Tomato, 3000g
products.description: Tomatoes did not start in Italy, but the Italians found the best place to grown them - the San Marzano Valley outside of Naples in Southern Italy. The Strianese company is a great producer of DOP (Denominazione di Origine Protetta) and organic tomatoes. We have been using their products in our kitchen and in our homes for many years. Simple fact: you can't make great tomato sauce without using great tomatoes - these DOP tomatoes are where you start. Grown in the rich volcanic soils of Southern Italy, they are deep red in color, sweet and with very low acidity. Low in salt and with a single basil leaf, they are ready to be seasoned and cooked exactly the way you choose.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Arrabbiata Sauce, 680g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The best pasta deserves the best sauce, and their line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. Arrabbiata means “enraged," and this sauce, made with hot red pepper and garlic, is indeed very spicy. Great with any of their pasta cuts, especially Bucatini.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Olive Tomato Sauce, 680g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The best pasta deserves the best sauce, and their line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. Made with vine-ripened tomatoes, sauteed onions, and Italian black olives, this sauce goes well with any kind of pasta.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Pomodoro e Basilico, 680g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The best pasta deserves the best sauce. This line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. A classic pairing of tomatoes and basil. Perfect with your favorite cut of pasta, when you are making chicken cacciatore, or as base for seafood stews.

products.name: Bianco di Napoli Tomato/Basil, 24oz
products.description: This is a deliciously simply organic marinara sauce from James Beard Award winning restaurateur Chris Bianco and 3rd generation tomato processor Rob DiNapoli. Produced from 5 simple organic ingredients harvested at their peak ripeness- tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, basil and sea salt. All ingredients grown in California!

products.name: Pomi Marinara Sauce, 26oz

Enjoy as is, or add some herbs, spices and aromatics - you are ready for pizza night at home.

products.name: Exclusivo Wild Porcini Sauce, 879g
products.description: This sauce has been a customer favorite for many years. Made with vine ripened california tomatoes, porcini mushrooms and fresh eggplant, it's about as close to homemade as you can get! Great for pasta, pizza or in lasagna!

products.name: La Medina Semi-Dried Tomatoes, 540g
products.description: These semi-sundried tomatoes are versatile, convenient and packed with flavor! They are hand-picked and hand-cut tomatoes marinated in sunflower oil, vinegar, herbs, spices and seasonings. Much more tender than sundried tomatoes, they are perfect for salads, pastas and pizza. No need to discard the oil, either - you can reuse it to marinate something else, use it for dressings, or incorporate it into mayonaisse.

products.name: DeLaurenti Alfredo Sauce, 250g
products.tagline: Italian white sauce with with cheese & cream
products.description: Get serious...really good cream sauce that is in a bottle? Yes! We've waiting a long time for this. Our great friends at Ritrovo Selections have again helped us by finding the best there is to find when it comes to all things imported from Italy. Our Alfredo has the cheesy richness that has come to be associated with this iconic cream sauce. All natural ingredients and Italian sourcing result in a creamy, decadent condiment for pastas such, fresh fettucine, or La Romagna Pappardelle. Heat and use to top steamed vegetables, fill crepes or make an Alfredo-topped eggs Benedict!

products.name: DeLaurenti Cacio e Pepe Sauce, 250g
products.tagline: Italian white sauce with DOP Pecorino Romano & black pepper
products.description: Get serious...really Cacio e Pepe sauce that is in a bottle? Yes! We've waiting a long time for this. Our great friends at Ritrovo Selections have again helped us by finding the best there is to find when it comes to all things imported from Italy. This sauce combines DOP pecorino romano cheese with fragrant black pepper in an all natural roux to create the classic Roman dish that dates back ages. Not just for pasta, this sauce can also dress up a grilled chicken breast or steak!

products.name: Rossodoro Sugo di Pomodoro, 16oz
products.description: This sauce is made by our neighbor Michela Tartaglia at Pasta Casalinga here at the Pike Place Market. It is the same sauce she uses for all their pasta dishes. Born and raised in Torino, Michela spent her summers on her Italian family’s olive farm near Naples. This sauce is part of a set of secrets and techniques she inherited from her mother and grandmothers. Fresh, flavorful & delicious!

products.name: SMT Crushed Tomatoes, 28oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. Conveniently crushed and ready to use!

products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. These whole peeled tomatoes are the go to for marinara & meat sauce!

products.name: SMT Arrabiata Sauce, 23.5oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This sauce has a pleasant, warm heat. Add some pancetta for a quick version of Bucatini all'Amatriciana - be sure to finish it with Pecorino Romano.

products.name: SMT Marinara Sauce, 23.5oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This classic marinara is a great sauce when you're in a pinch. Add sausage, pancetta, red pepper, mushrooms or enjoy it just as it is. Great with every cut of pasta.

products.name: SMT Pizza Sauce, 14oz
products.description: Good pizza sauce starts with good tomatoes. SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This is a great sauce for pizza night, quick and ready to go! A fine backdrop for all your favorite cheeses and pizza toppings.

products.name: SMT Tomato Basil Sauce, 23.5oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This is a great sauce for light pastas in the spring & summer. It also serves as a great base that can be customized depending on what you are cooking. It has a clean, bright flavor with just a hint of aromatic basil.

products.name: SMT Tomato Paste, 4.5oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This tomato paste is double concentrated and packaged neatly in a no waste squeeze tube. Use a little to thicken sauces and soups, when done, stow it in the fridge until you are ready to use it again.

products.name: SMT Vodka Sauce, 23.5oz
products.description: SMT combines as many as 18 different varieties of tomato seeds during their early, mid & late harvest. Their proprietary standard and growing process gives their tomatoes and sauces their incredible aroma & flavor. This vodka sauce with a touch of cream is perfect for weeknight meals. It is good to go just as it is. Choose your favorite cut of pasta and finish it with Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.name: Cento White Clam Sauce, 425g
products.description: The old school classic. Clams mixed with a special blend of herbs, spices & extra virgin olive oil. Ready to heat and toss with your linguine!

products.name: Contorno Tomato Concentrate, 200g
products.description: Fratelli Contorno is a Sicilian canned foods producer established in 1916. Four generations later, they continue to focus on Sicilian regional specialties – but unlike 1916, they now produce their goods in a solar-powered production facility. Dense and flavorful, it’s perfect for enriching sauces, soups, or braises.

products.name: Cuoco Pasta con Sarde, 15oz
products.description: Cuoco Brand hails from Sicily. Their Cuoco Seasoning for Macaroni with Sardines has been on the shelves at DeLaurenti for longer than any of us have been here. It is the authentic seasoning for the classic Sicilian dish Pasta con Le Sarde. The balanced sauce gets its saltiness and bite from sardines and rich flavors from wild fennel, onions, and raisins. Various types of pasta can be used, but bucatini is traditional.

products.name: Don Pomodoro Arrabbiata Pasta Sauce, 25oz
products.description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their arrabbiata sauce allows you to enjoy a great meal in the time it takes to boil your pasta. Calabrian red chiles add a warm spice to this sauce, balanced with Italian tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, carrots, and garlic. Your next weeknight dinner awaits!

products.name: Don Pomodoro Marinara, 25oz
products.description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their marinara sauce is a great choice for anyone who wants the convenience of a prepared pasta sauce, but doesn’t want an over-sweetened mass-market marinara. Made without added sugar, this sauce is simple yet delicious. You will recognize and be able to pronounce all the ingredient on the back of the jar. Enjoy it as is, or customize with sausage, vegetables or both!

products.name: Don Pomodoro Puttanesca, 25oz
products.description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their puttanesca sauce tastes like southern Italy. Made with onions, green olives, and capers, it is an easy way to craft a delicious meal in the time it takes to boil your pasta. Great enjoyed as is, or add a little more character by sautéing a few anchovies in some chili flakes before adding the sauce to the pan. Want to keep going? Add some tuna & finish it with fresh chopped Italian parsley!

products.name: Don Pomodoro Tomato & Basil Pasta Sauce, 25oz
products.description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy, with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their Tomato & Basil Pasta Sauce starts with a soffritto of onion, carrots, and garlic to form a base before the premium San Marzano tomatoes and extra virgin olive oil are added. The sauce is finished with fresh basil harvested daily from the Don Pomodoro fields. With this sauce, you can make a delicious pasta in about the time it takes to cook the noodles. To make it as the Italians do, add the al dente pasta to the sauce and give it a quick finish. Save a bit of the cooking water to add to the finished dish to get the desired consistency.

products.name: Gia Sundried Tomato Paste, 80g
products.description: When you need tomato paste, nothing else will do. If you happen to love using this miracle ingredient for sauces, braises and soups but feel like adding the distinctive taste of sundried tomatoes, this is the stuff. It combines the same smooth texture and versatility with sundried tomatoes, olvie oil, herbs & spices. And you know how to use it already!

products.name: Paradiso dei Golosi Sundried Tomatoes, 5.3oz
products.description: Grown in Puglia, the heal of the Italian boot, these sundried tomatoes are made without additives or sulfur. Tender and vine-ripened, they have the natural balance of sweetness and acidity.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Pesto Rosso, 180g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is a Sicilian spin on a classic recipe that captures all the sun-drenched flavors of southern Italy. This sun-dried tomato and almond pesto is wonderful with pasta, bruschetta, or grilled pork, chicken or fish.

products.name: Segreti di Sicilia Sugo alle Olive, 290g
products.description: Sicilian cuisine tells the story of the many cultures that have intersected on the island—Greek, Arab, French, and Spanish. Frantoi Cutrera’s line of Segreti di Sicilia products is made exclusively with ingredients from Sicily and from traditional Sicilian recipes. They are good enough to serve to company or for a quick pasta dinner. Their Sugo alle Olive is made with Sicilian green (Nocellara Etnea) and black olives (Tonda Iblea) and seasoned with onion, red garlic, red pepper, and a premium extra virgin olive oil made from the same green olives used in the sauce.

products.name: Segreti di Sicilia Tonno con Capperi, 290g
products.description: Sicilian cuisine tells the story of the many cultures that have intersected on the island—Greek, Arab, French, and Spanish. Frantoi Cutrera’s line of Segreti di Sicilia products is made exclusively with ingredients from Sicily and from traditional Sicilian recipes. They are good enough to serve to company or for a quick pasta dinner. Their Tonno con Capperi is a classic example of the Spanish influence in Sicilian food. Capers add tang to the rich tomato sauce and meaty tuna. Italian parsley enhances the flavor, and red pepper lends a slight spice.

products.name: Tutto Calabria Hot Spaghetti Sauce, 190g
products.description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Their hot spaghetti sauce uses both sweet and hot peppers, vine-ripened tomatoes, garlic and basil for a complex, spicy flavor. It’s great for more than just pasta, too! Try it as a sandwich condiment, or as a spicy pizza sauce!
